title: HackerEarth: Charged Up Array
description: An array of size `N` is given. An element `arr[i]` is charged up if its value is greater than or equal to `2^(N - 1)`. Calculate the sum of all charged up elements modulo 10^9 + 7. If N >= 60, threshold is 2^59.
solution:
def charged_up_sum(arr: list[int]) -> int:
    n = len(arr)
    threshold = 1 << (min(n - 1, 59))
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    return sum(x for x in arr if x >= threshold) % MOD
explanation: Checks if element >= 2^(N - 1) and sums valid items mod 10^9+7 in O(N) time.
